title: ws-hwdrivers stream 3: als-manual (audio_als_manual_set_brightness_4ae81c, audio_als_manual_recalculate_4adcd8) verified vs stock

method.emulator: Renode 1.17.0, CPU CortexM cortex-m55, FPU on
method.harness: build/ws-hwdrivers-20261122/harness (hw.repl/harness.c/rt.S/tramp.S + per-unit gen_<unit>.c), final arg-comparing + VFP-aware harness
method.compare: per test: return value, stub-call arg lists (0xB7), i2c transaction + 128x256 register-image diff, caller/global dump images, register diffs. Stack-local and elog string-literal pointers canonicalized.

harness_fidelity_fixes: ROOT CAUSE of initial 0/12: at -Oz clang coalesces the unit's small .bss globals into one section .bss..L_MergedGlobals with no per-name symbols, so the placement linker script KEEP(*(.bss.<name>)) matched nothing and the C globals (audio_als_manual_ready @0x200741c0, audio_als_manual_window @0x20073c98) stayed in default .bss (zeroed) while setup_data seeded the stock addresses. C read 0/garbage -> diverged from stock which reads the seeded stock RAM.

FIX: build2.sh CFLAGS += -fno-common -mllvm -arm-global-merge=false. Each global now gets its own .bss.<name> section and places at its stock address. Confirmed stock reads audio_als_manual_ready from 0x200741c0 (literal @0x4ae984) = same address the C declares, so the C reconstruction was already faithful; the fix was purely a harness placement/codegen-fidelity issue.
